name: Aversion to Fire
description: Fears open fire and must make a Will save to approach or attack a fire source.

name: Aversion to Mirrors
description: Cannot approach within 30 ft. of a presented mirror without failing a Will save.

name: Fragile
description: Brittle anatomy; takes +50% damage from bludgeoning and sonic attacks, -4 on saves vs shatter.

name: Light Blindness
description: Blinded for 1 round upon exposure to bright light, and dazzled on subsequent rounds.

name: Light Sensitivity
description: Dazzled in areas of bright sunlight or daylight spell (-1 on attacks and sight Perception).

name: Resurrection Vulnerability
description: Raise dead, resurrection, or heal spells deal massive damage or destroy the creature (Will save).

name: Salt Vulnerability
description: Contact with salt or immersion in salt water deals 1d6 lethal damage per round.

name: Sunlight Helplessness
description: Completely helpless and paralyzed when exposed to direct natural sunlight.

name: Sunlight Powerlessness
description: Utterly powerless in natural sunlight; cannot attack and is considered staggered or helpless.

name: Sunlight Vulnerability
description: Direct sunlight deals 1d6 damage or 1 Con drain per round until destroyed.

name: Susceptible to Wood
description: Vulnerable to wooden weapons or stakes driven through the heart (as vampires).

name: Vulnerability to Acid
description: Takes +50% damage from acid attacks, regardless of saving throws.

name: Vulnerability to Adamantine
description: Adamantine weapons bypass hardness and damage reduction.

name: Vulnerability to Cold
description: Takes +50% damage from cold attacks, regardless of saving throws.

name: Vulnerability to Cold Iron
description: Cold iron weapons bypass damage reduction and suppress regeneration.

name: Vulnerability to Electricity
description: Takes +50% damage from electricity attacks, regardless of saving throws.

name: Vulnerability to Fire
description: Takes +50% damage from fire attacks, regardless of saving throws.

name: Vulnerability to Force
description: Takes +50% damage from force damage spells and effects.

name: Vulnerability to Holy Water
description: Holy water deals damage as if the creature were undead or an evil outsider (2d4 damage per flask).

name: Vulnerability to Negative Energy
description: Takes +50% damage from negative energy attacks, regardless of saving throws.

name: Vulnerability to Positive Energy
description: Takes +50% damage from positive energy attacks, regardless of saving throws.

name: Vulnerability to Silver
description: Silver weapons bypass damage reduction and deal extra damage against this creature.

name: Vulnerability to Sonic
description: Takes +50% damage from sonic attacks, regardless of saving throws.

name: Water Dependency
description: Can survive out of water for only 1 hour per 2 points of Con before suffocating.
